summary: Tianci International, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting that its wholly owned subsidiary, Tianci Group Holding Limited, entered into an Equipment Procurement Agreement with McQueen Tech Co., Limited to purchase US$500,000 of Bitmain Model S21 XP cryptocurrency mining equipment. The agreement includes hosting and advisory services at no additional cost. Payment terms: US$250,000 due by August 31, 2026, with the remainder due after inspection. The company intends to enter the cryptocurrency mining business. This is a routine supply/procurement contract, not a special-situation event; no equity, M&A, or strategic restructuring is involved.
